summary:
Implemented the Maintenance closeout receipt slice.

Added a saved receipt inside Quick Maintenance Update after a closeout save. It shows the saved service, mileage, note, and Garage Notes confirmation, with Copy Receipt, Share, and Open Garage actions. Also updated search metadata, service worker cache to `v349`, Anton state/status, and browser-smoke coverage.

`Invoke-SiteAudit.ps1 -Pages @('maintenance.html') -Tag audit-v349-maintenance-receipt -SkipScreenshots`
`Invoke-BrowserSmoke.ps1 -Pages @('index.html')`

Next safe slice: Garage first-record empty-state polish, shared Search real-iPhone review, or real-iPhone review of the Maintenance receipt share sheet.
